description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2520015031768 PLATE,INTERMEDIATE,: Line 0001 Qty 1126 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0112 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
